models.name: todo_list_users
models.description:
User accounts with unique email-based authentication.

Represents the sole actor type for the Todo List application. Each record stores the credentials and identity required for exclusive user ownership of todo items. Email serves as the unique business identifier for authentication and communication.

Password hashes implement security best practices; plain text passwords are never stored. Users may have multiple concurrent sessions, tracked separately in 'todo_list_user_sessions'.

This model is only referenced by its own authentication and relationship flows; no business data or soft deletion are present.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: User's email address for authentication and account identification. Must be unique across all users; used as the primary business login field.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Secure hash of the user's password for credential verification. Never stores raw or unhashed passwords; required for all authentication flows.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for when the user account was created.

models.name: todo_list_user_sessions
models.description:
Session records for authenticated user logins.

Stores each session created when a user logs in, supporting secure, auditable session invalidation and tracking. Each record details when and from where the user accessed the service, associated with the parent user account. Multiple concurrent sessions per user are supported for multi-device access.

Follows canonical session-fields pattern: IP address, referrer, and connecting URL are required for every session. Session conclusion is tracked via the 'expired_at' field. No other fields (token, device, user agent, etc.) are present for strict compliance.

Deletion of a session immediately invalidates its record; no soft delete or restoration mechanism exists. This table is managed exclusively through authentication flows and referenced only by user ID foreign key.

foreignFields.name: todo_list_user_id
foreignFields.description: References the owning user account for this session. Ensures auditability and precise relationship between session and principal actor. {@link todo_list_users.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the session originated. Provides context for session security auditing and suspicious login detection.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Full URL at which this session was initiated. Used for audit trail and debugging session issues.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL indicating where the session started, if available; otherwise records the login screen URL.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for when the session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session ended or expired. Nullable for active sessions; set when explicit logout or session expiration occurs.

models.name: todo_list_todos
models.description:
Main business entity representing a single todo item owned by a user.

This table stores the minimal, per-user todo tasks that implement the entire business workflow for the application. Each row represents a private task created by one authenticated user and is uniquely identified by a UUID-based primary key. The model enforces strict user ownership via a foreign key reference to the users table (todo_list_users), supporting fast queries and guaranteeing data isolation required by business rules.

Todos include a required title, an optional description, a boolean completion flag, and an optional completion timestamp (set only when marked complete). Creation and last-modified audit timestamps are included to support ordering, filtering, and user audit transparency. Business logic around quotas, validation, and user-only access is expected to be handled at the application layer in conjunction with these schema constraints. No soft deletion is supported—deletion is always permanent by business mandate. This model implements all production requirements for the MVP todo management domain.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key for unique identification of each todo item.

foreignFields.name: user_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the owning user. Enforces strict data isolation; each todo belongs to exactly one user. {@link todo_list_users.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Required, user-defined short label for the todo item. Must be non-empty and a maximum of 255 characters. Used for listing and main identification.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional detailed text field for the todo's additional context. Allows up to 1000 characters; may be null if no detail is provided.

plainFields.name: completed
plainFields.description: Boolean status indicating whether the todo is marked complete by the user. Defaults to false on creation; set true when completed.

plainFields.name: completed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for when the todo was marked as complete. Null if todo is not completed; set only at moment of completion.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo item was first created. Used for sorting and audit trails.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the todo. Updated on any modification, including changes to title, description, or completed status.
